callouts.title: 线性算子的迹的定义
callouts.body: 假设$V$是定义在复数域上的线性空间，$\mathscr{A}\in \mathcal{L}(V)$是$V$上的线性算子，假设其全体特征值为$\lambda_1,...,\lambda_n$,那么其迹被定义为其所有特征值的和，每个特征按照代数重数重复计算,即$$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}):=\sum_{i\leq n}\lambda_i$$特别的如果$V$是定义在实数域上的线性空间，那么算子$\mathscr{A}$的迹定义为其在复数域上的所有特征值的和。

classification_result.english_title: Definition of the Trace of a Linear Operator

callouts.title: 方阵的迹的定义
callouts.body: 矩阵$M=(a_{i,j})$是定义在实数或者复数域上的n阶矩阵，那么矩阵的迹定义为其对角线元素之和，即$$\text{trace}(M):=\sum_{i\leq n}a_{ii}$$

classification_result.english_title: Definition of the Trace of a Square Matrix

if_problem.statement_en: The trace of matrices is commutative, i.e. for square matrices of compatible size, $\text{trace}(AB)=\text{trace}(BA)$.
key_techniques: expanding the trace as a sum of diagonal entries

callouts.title: 性质2
callouts.body: 矩阵的迹在相似变换下是不变的。

if_problem.statement_en: The trace of a matrix is invariant under similarity transformations.

callouts.title: 性质3
callouts.body: 矩阵的迹是线性的。即如果有两个n阶方程$A,B$那么成立等式$$\text{trace}(aA+bB)=a\,\text{trace}(A)+b\,\text{trace}(B)$$其中$a,b$是两个常数。

if_problem.statement_en: The trace of a matrix is linear. That is, for two $n\times n$ matrices $A,B$, one has $$\text{trace}(aA+bB)=a\,\text{trace}(A)+b\,\text{trace}(B),$$ where $a,b$ are constants.

callouts.title: Schur分解定理
callouts.body: n阶复矩阵$A$酉相似(unitary similarity)于一个上三角矩阵$T$,即存在一个酉矩阵(unitary matrix)$Q$使得$$A=QTQ^{\dagger}$$并且上三角矩阵$T$的对角线为矩阵$A$的特征值。

if_problem.statement_en: Every complex $n\times n$ matrix $A$ is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix $T$, that is, there exists a unitary matrix $Q$ such that $$A=QTQ^{\dagger},$$ and the diagonal entries of $T$ are the eigenvalues of $A$.

callouts.title: 线性算子的迹的性质
callouts.body:
1. 算子交换迹不变：$$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}\circ \mathscr{B})=\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}\circ \mathscr{A})$$
2. 算子的迹矩阵是线性的:$$\text{trace}(a\mathscr{A}+b\mathscr{B})=a \,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})+b \,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})$$其中$a,b$是两个常数。

classification_result.english_title: Properties of the Trace of a Linear Operator

if_problem.statement_en: For linear operators $\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B}$, the trace satisfies: 1. $$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}\circ \mathscr{B})=\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}\circ \mathscr{A}).$$ 2. $$\text{trace}(a\mathscr{A}+b\mathscr{B})=a\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})+b\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}),$$ where $a,b$ are constants.
